dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hm, your movements are quite practiced, and your potion meets the requirements as well. Congratulations on passing the Beginner exam!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, that was a piece of cake!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Even so, it was no match for your skills.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, I believe I've collected all the necessary feedback... Looks like we'll have to make some adjustments to the level of difficulty for the actual exam.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #I'm going to head back to the lab now. See you later, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wow... I really thought it would be more difficult for someone so new to potion-making.
